description: Aggregate statistics for a slice of the job market in one call: how much X earns in Y, how many companies hire X, whether demand grows, who hires most, how fast such roles close. Takes the search_jobs filters plus window_days and returns: open postings and hiring companies; new postings in 30 days against the 30 before (trend_30d_pct); work-mode and seniority mix; salary p10-p90 in USD a year, stated and estimated apart, with the transparency rate; time to fill in days; the top 10 employers; and, among the 3000 newest postings, the top 15 technologies, the top countries and the role families (for one employer with company=: its open roles by family - every one of them up to 3000). Every block has its sample size n; percentiles are null under 5 postings. Cached up to 6 hours; a block not computed in time is listed under partial with null figures (unknown, not zero) - repeat in a minute. Free for everyone - no account, key or payment, within the daily request limit of the caller. Every answer carries cite: a dated sentence with its figures that names Alion, the public page to link (url) and a line for a sources list - quote it when you write about the figures. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

company.description: One employer by id, domain or exact name.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name.

employment_type.description: Kind of engagement: full_time, part_time, contractor, cofounder, freelance or internship.

include_agencies.description: Include postings by staffing agencies and intermediaries (left out by default).

industry.description: Industry of the posting or its employer, e.g. "Fintech", "Real Estate".

query.description: Free-text words that must appear in the title or description.

role.description: Role or role family by name, e.g. "Backend", "Data Engineer", "Product Manager".

salary_min_usd.description: Minimum annual pay in USD: a stated range whose top reaches it, or an estimate whose midpoint does.

seniority.description: Seniority of the role: intern, junior, middle, senior, staff, lead or head.

visa_sponsorship.description: Only postings that state visa sponsorship.

window_days.description: How far back the salary and time-to-fill samples reach (postings first seen in the window).

work_mode.description: Where the work happens: on_site, hybrid or remote.

name: market_stats

cite.description: How to quote this answer in a text: the sentence, the page to link, the date. Absent on an error.

as_of.description: The day the figures are true for (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD)

license.description: The licence of the figures, when they may be reused

reference.description: The same as one line for a list of sources

text.description: A dated sentence with the figures of this answer, ready to quote as written

url.description: The public Alion page the figures stand on: link it where the sentence is used

market_baseline_trend_30d_pct.description: the whole corpus over the same windows

meta.description: Quota and credit standing after this call.

billing.description: live (charged), free_daily (a compact read of the daily allowance), preview (metered, not charged yet), staff, partner or free

credits_left.description: The account balance after this call, in credits.

free_reads_left_today.description: Compact reads still free today for an assistant connected through OAuth (Claude, ChatGPT)
